meta.title: FINALS HQ · THE FINALS leaderboards and profiles
meta.description: Leaderboards, profiles and progression of THE FINALS players, tracked every 10 minutes. Fan project, not affiliated with Embark Studios.

meta.playerDescriptionNone: {name}: chart, activity and career in THE FINALS public leaderboards, on FINALS HQ.
meta.top500Description: The RS of the 500th Ranked Cashout player ({season}) live, its curve, its projection and past seasons' thresholds.
meta.clubsDescription: THE FINALS club ranking ({season}) based on members in the top 10,000.
meta.clubDescription: Members of club [{tag}] ranked in the Ranked Cashout top 10,000 ({season}).
meta.moversDescription: The biggest RS gains and losses in Ranked Cashout ({season}).
meta.compareDescription: Compare 2 to 4 THE FINALS players ({season}): rank, RS, progress, career.

status.title: Data status

profile.whereHint: Top 10,000 players per division at the last snapshot; the league comes from the API. Your division is circled.

profile.neverSeenLive: Not seen on the {season} ranked leaderboard since collection started ({date}).

career.badgeFirst: {count, plural, one {#1 of a season} other {#1 of # seasons}}
career.badgeSeasons: {count, plural, one {# ranked season} other {# ranked seasons}}
career.legacyExplain: {points} career points: 100 per season finished in the top 500 (+40 top 100, +60 #1), 60 in Diamond, 30 in Platinum, 10 for being in the top 10,000.
career.legacyScale: Legacy = 100 × (1 − e^(−points/250)): every season counts, with diminishing returns. It is 5% of the upcoming Rating.
career.noLeaguesHint: Betas, S1 and S2: no comparable league system, the season counts as a presence.
career.noRanked: Not in the top 10,000 of this season's ranked leaderboard.
career.coverage: Finished seasons from the public archives ({archived} ranked leaderboards). Before 4-digit names, a season is linked only when the name matches exactly.
career.empty: No past season in the archives
career.emptyHint: This player does not appear on any finished leaderboard under this name (top 10,000 of each season).

following.intro: Your list lives in your browser: no account, nothing stored on our side. Export it to use it on another device.
following.emptyHint: Open a profile and tap ☆ Follow: the player will show up here with their rank and today's change.
following.loadError: Could not load the players. Try again in a moment.
following.stored: {count, plural, one {# player stored in your browser} other {# players stored in your browser}} (50 max).

following.importError: Unreadable file: pick a FINALS HQ export.

top500.title: Top 500 line
top500.intro: The RS of the 500th player, recorded every 10 minutes. In past seasons, the end-of-season top 500 earned the Ruby league.
top500.introRuby: The Ruby league has appeared on the leaderboard: it covers the top of the top 500. The line tracks the 500th player's RS, recorded every 10 minutes.
top500.kpi7dPending: after 7 days of snapshots ({span} so far)
top500.kpiLastFooter: entry to the public leaderboard ({count} rows)
top500.chartEmpty: History building: first snapshot on {date}, come back in a few hours for the curve.
top500.legend: Solid line: snapshots. Grey dots: 7-day trend. Red area: projection, updated with every snapshot.
top500.projectionBody: The 500th gains about {slope} RS per day over the last 7 days (between {low} and {high} depending on snapshot pairs).
top500.coverage: Check: {pct}% of the {count} snapshots of the last 7 days fall inside the range drawn on the curve.
top500.projectionPending: The projection appears after 7 days of snapshots so a single day is never extrapolated. So far: {span} of snapshots; available on {date}.
top500.projectionMethod: Method: robust trend (median of slopes between snapshots, known as Theil-Sen) over 7 days, range widened by the observed noise. It is an estimate, not game data; the season end date is not known.
top500.aroundEmpty: Fewer than 500 players on the leaderboard.
top500.followed: Your followed players vs the line
top500.followedEmpty: Follow players from their profile to see here how far they are from the top 500.
top500.followedError: Could not load your followed players right now.
top500.pastHint: Final RS of the 500th in each archived season since Season 3 (crossplay leaderboard when it exists; before that the score was not RS). Scales change between seasons: compare orders of magnitude, not exact numbers.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.intro: {count} clubs have at least one member in the Ranked Cashout top 10,000 ({season}). Ranked by the combined RS of those members.
clubs.noneHint: Only clubs with a member in the top 10,000 are listed.
clubs.found: {count, plural, one {# club} other {# clubs}} for “{q}”
clubs.note: Only members ranked in the top 10,000 are visible: the API does not give a club's full roster. # is the position by combined RS.

club.notFoundHint: No member of this club was seen in our snapshots. Check the tag.
club.noMembersHint: The club was last seen on {date}; its members have left the top 10,000.
club.kpiTop500: {count, plural, one {# in the top 500} other {# in the top 500}}
club.note: Only members ranked in the top 10,000 are visible.
club.onBoard: See these members on the leaderboard

intro.24h: RS change over the last 24 hours, among top 10,000 players.
intro.7d: RS change over a rolling 7 days, among top 10,000 players.

movers.empty7d: The 7-day change appears after one week of collection (started on {date}).
movers.emptyHint: No change recorded over this period.
movers.note: Hidden profiles excluded. A player who entered the top 10,000 during the period has no change until they were recorded at the start of the window.

compare.title: Compare
compare.intro: 2 to 4 players side by side on Ranked Cashout ({season}) and their careers. The page address can be shared as is.
compare.emptyHint: Search for a first player above, then a second. Tip: the “Compare” button on a profile opens this page with that player already picked.
compare.oneHint: Add a second player to start the comparison.
compare.lastSeen: Outside the top 10,000 · seen on {date} at {score} RS
compare.legend: Highlighted: best value of the row. Greyed column: player outside the top 10,000. Legacy = career component of the upcoming Rating (0 to 100).
compare.chartEmpty: Not enough snapshots yet to draw the curves.
